name: robot-md
description: Connect a robot to Claude through its ROBOT.md: read capabilities and safety limits, route any motion through robot-md-gateway, keep AI-driven motion behind a gate and test its limits with Bounded Embodiment, and manage its identity, keys and EU AI Act evidence at the Robot Registry Foundation. Requires robot-md 2.0.1 or newer (`pip install 'robot-md[hardware]>=2.0.1'`); the MCP server's launcher refuses an older robot-md.
